sorrow-knight.summary: A fighter who turns a deep personal loss into Shadowfell despair, burdening foes with grief while guarding others from the same pain.

Despairing Strikes.summary: Three d8 Despairing Strike Dice (four d10s at Fighter 10, five d12s at 15), all back on a Short or Long Rest. On a weapon hit, spend one (max one per attack) for that much extra Psychic damage plus, if you like, one effect (Abandoned or Dread); save DC 8 + PB + WIS.

options.name: Abandoned
options.summary: INT save or Deafened until the end of your next turn, treating every creature it sees as an enemy meanwhile.

options.name: Dread
options.summary: Disadvantage on its next saving throw before your next turn starts.

Solemn Gaze.summary: Darkvision 60 ft (or +60 ft if you have it). Magic action, WIS modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest: a creature you see within 30 ft makes a WIS save (DC 8 + PB + WIS) or you learn one strong emotion it holds; if it can see you, it knows.

Dreaded Appearance.summary: Tactical Shift can teleport you up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you see. Once per Short or Long Rest, on arriving, creatures you choose in a 10-ft Emanation make a WIS save (DC 8 + PB + WIS): a failure means Psychic damage of one Despairing Strike Die roll and Frightened until your next turn ends; a success, half damage.

Unsettled Strikes.summary: Three more Despairing Strike effects: Apathetic, Lost and Weary.

options.name: Apathetic
options.summary: WIS save or Incapacitated until your next turn starts, answering only in single words.

options.name: Lost
options.summary: CHA save: a failure leaves it Blinded with Speed 0 through its next turn; a success halves its Speed for that long.

options.name: Weary
options.summary: CON save or 1 Exhaustion level (this can't push it past 2), removed when your next turn ends.

Grim Constitution.summary: Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic. When something would lower your HP maximum, a DC 15 CON save stops it; the DC rises by 5 per later save and resets to 15 after a Short or Long Rest.

Grieving Mantle.summary: Action Surge also attunes you to the Shadowfell for 1 minute (ends if you're Incapacitated): immune to Charmed and Frightened (ending them if present), and as a Reaction when an attack roll hits you, turn insubstantial and take 0 damage from it.

options.name: Shade Form
options.summary: Reaction when an attack roll hits you: its damage to you drops to 0.

options.name: Unwavering Resolve
options.summary: Immune to Charmed and Frightened; either ends on you when the mantle starts.
